The <b>Great Gourmand</b> is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Background ==
The Great Gourmand is a connoisseur whose tastes transcend the ages.<ref>[[Loyal Mergwin]]: <i>"The Great Gourmand! The finest connoisseur who has ever lived, the one whose tastes transcend the ages! None are left now who venerate them as they deserve, save for the loyal, lonely bug who stands before you."</i></ref>

{{MissingInfo}}

== In-game Events ==
Once Hornet fulfils the <i>[[Great Taste of Pharloom]]</i> [[wish]], the Great Gourmand feasts with haste upon the dish created by [[Loyal Mergwin]]. After eating, the Great Gourmand reflects upon his meal in silence.<ref>Loyal Mergwin: <i>"Leave us! My great master needs time to reflect, and I must ponder on flavours anew!"</i></ref>

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* ...EAT... EAT...
* ...FOOD... MEAT... MUCH...
* ...EAT... FEED...
* ...MUCH... EAT... GOOD...
}}

== Location ==
The Great Gourmand can be found in the dining chamber of the [[Choral Chambers]], once the <i>[[Great Taste of Pharloom]]</i> [[wish]] is completed.
